suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: When consolidating duplicate tests, prefer parameterized test patterns (for loops over assertion arrays/cases) to reduce test count while maintaining coverage. This pattern was used successfully in remote_log.rs, discovery.rs, http.rs consolidation, command.rs, and command_parser.rs.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Table-driven test consolidation used across 5+ features: command.rs (50→4 tests), command_parser.rs (53→7 tests), remote_log.rs, discovery.rs, http.rs. All preserved coverage while reducing test count significantly.
